s: How much in loans did the Centre report disbursing for 17 externally aided projects in Andhra Pradesh under the Special Assistance Measure?
x: The Centre reported disbursing Rs 7,798 crore for 17 EAPs, the largest being VCIC (Rs 1,859 crore).

s: Which organisation is the implementing agency for Amaravati works?
x: APCRDA is the implementing agency for Amaravati works.

s: Which agency implements the AP Rural Inclusive Growth Project?
x: SERP implements the Rural Inclusive Growth Project; its PMU is headed by SERP's CEO.

s: Which agency implements the KfW-funded AP Climate Resilient Zero Budget Natural Farming (APCNF) programme?
x: APCNF, funded by a KfW loan, is implemented by Rythu Sadhikara Samstha.

s: Which agency supports the Green Energy Corridor Phase-I in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Green Energy Corridor Phase-I is funded by KfW; APIIATP is a World Bank project and SAPAP is supported by UNDP.

s: What is the size of the World Bank loan for Amaravati Capital City Phase-I?
x: The World Bank approved $800 million on 19 December 2024; $788.8 million is the ADB loan.

s: In which currency are both multilateral loans for Amaravati Capital City Phase-I disbursed?
x: Both the World Bank and ADB loans for Amaravati Phase-I are disbursed in Japanese yen.

s:
Consider the following statements about Amaravati Capital City Phase-I funding:
1. The ADB loan is a results-based loan of $788.8 million.
2. HUDCO and NABARD are part of the Phase-I multilateral funding.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: The ADB gave a $788.8 million results-based loan; HUDCO and NABARD are domestic loans, not Phase-I multilateral funding.

s: Which bank approved a results-based loan of $788.8 million for Amaravati Capital City Phase-I in December 2024?
x: ADB gave a results-based loan of $788.8 million; the World Bank's loan was $800 million.

s: On which date did the World Bank approve its $800 million loan for the Amaravati Integrated Urban Development Programme?
x: The World Bank approved the $800 million Amaravati loan on 19 December 2024.

s: The Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor is the first phase of which larger corridor idea?
x: VCIC, funded by ADB, is the first phase of the East Coast Economic Corridor idea.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about ADB projects in Andhra Pradesh?
o: ADB funds the Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor
ADB is a co-lender for Amaravati Phase-I with the World Bank
x: APCRDA implements Amaravati works, not VCIC.

s: What is the main aim of the proposed NDB Phase-II road projects in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Build six-lane expressways between port cities
Provide double-lane links from district headquarters to mandal headquarters
x: NDB Phase-II (APRBRP 539.45 km of State highways and APMCRCIP 728.59 km of MDR/ODR) aims at double-lane district-to-mandal HQ links. Expressways, feeder electrification and Amaravati-only roads are not its aim.

s: The NDB-supported road projects in Andhra Pradesh involve which financing ratio between NDB and the State?
x: The NDB-to-State financing ratio for the road projects is 70:30.

s: What is the funding share of KfW : NCEF : APTRANSCO under Green Energy Corridor Phase-I in AP?
x: GEC Phase-I is funded KfW 40%, NCEF 40% and APTRANSCO 20%.

s: NDB Phase-I road projects in Andhra Pradesh cover about how many km?
x: NDB Phase-I is ₹3,014 crore for 1,243 km; 850 km is the World Bank road project.

s: AIIB assistance in Andhra Pradesh is tracked by the Online Works Monitoring System covering how many ULBs?
x: The system tracks 800+ projects in 123 ULBs, including AIIB works.

s: How many packages does the KfW-funded Green Energy Corridor Phase-I in Andhra Pradesh have?
x: GEC Phase-I is worth Rs 1,379.75 crore in 8 packages and was fully completed by December 2025.

s: What was the size of the KfW loan for AP Climate Resilient Zero Budget Natural Farming (APCNF)?
x: KfW gave a loan of EUR 90 million plus a EUR 1 million grant; the Rs 711 crore loan pact was signed in January 2020.

s: By when was the KfW-funded Green Energy Corridor Phase-I in Andhra Pradesh fully completed?
x: Only 4 of 8 packages were done in 2024-25; the SES 2025-26 says the project was fully completed by December 2025.

s: Which bank gave its first loan in India for the 'Andhra Pradesh 24x7 Power for All' project?
x: In May 2017 AIIB approved US$160 million for AP's 24x7 Power for All, its first project in India, co-financed with the World Bank.

s: How much did AIIB approve in 2017 for the Andhra Pradesh 24x7 Power for All project?
x: AIIB approved a US$160 million loan; the World Bank co-financed the project with US$240 million.

s: How much did the AP Rural Roads EAP head funded by NDB get in the Union Budget 2026-27?
x: AP Rural Roads (NDB) got ₹500.99 crore; ₹350 crore went to Roads & Bridges Reconstruction and ₹155.32 crore to APCNF.

s: Through which lender was the Amaravati Integrated Urban Development Programme allocation routed in the Union Budget 2026-27?
x: ₹432.09 crore was provided for the Amaravati programme through IBRD.

s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
x: APCRDA implements Amaravati works, not the Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor, so that pair is wrongly matched. R&B implements the NDB roads, SERP the Rural Inclusive Growth Project and APTRANSCO the Green Energy Corridor.

s: For which regions does Section 46(2)-(3) of the A.P. Reorganisation Act, 2014 mainly provide a special development package?
o: Rayalaseema and North Coastal Andhra Pradesh
x: Sec 46(2)-(3) asks the Centre to give appropriate grants and a special development package for backward areas, especially Rayalaseema and North Coastal AP; initial allocations were made, then disbursements stalled. Hyderabad is in Telangana; the delta and capital region are not named.

s: How much does the backward districts package for Andhra Pradesh provide each covered district?
x: The package gives Rs 50 crore per district per year to seven districts (4 Rayalaseema + 3 North Coastal), i.e. Rs 350 crore in all.

s: Which one of the following sets contains only the Rayalaseema districts covered under the backward districts package?
o: YSR Kadapa, Srikakulam, Anantapur and Vizianagaram
Anantapur, Kurnool, YSR Kadapa and Chittoor
x: The four Rayalaseema districts in the package were Anantapur, Kurnool, YSR Kadapa and Chittoor.

s: AP's special package for backward districts was modelled on Odisha's KBK package and which other package?
x: The backward-district package drew on the KBK (Koraput-Bolangir-Kalahandi) package of Odisha and the Bundelkhand special package.

s: What was the adequacy issue concerning the backward districts package?
o: Initial allocations were made, but disbursements stalled.
Only North Coastal districts received the allocation.
The entire amount was released in the first year.
No allocation was ever made for the districts.
x: Initial allocations were made, but stalled disbursements slowed regional development.

s: Under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014, the special development package for the backward districts of Rayalaseema and North Coastal Andhra Pradesh rests on which provisions?
x: Sec 46(2)-(3) provides for appropriate grants and a special development package for Rayalaseema and North Coastal AP, and Sec 94(2) for backward-area programmes. Sec 94(1) is about fiscal measures/tax incentives, Sec 90 is Polavaram, and Sec 46(1)/93/94(3) are not the stated basis.

s: How many districts were covered by the backward districts package for Andhra Pradesh?
x: Seven districts were covered: 4 of Rayalaseema and 3 of North Coastal AP.

s: What is the total size of the backward districts package for Andhra Pradesh (2016-17)?
x: Rs 50 crore per district for 7 districts gives Rs 350 crore a year.

s: Which section of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 provides for appropriate grants and a special development package for Rayalaseema and North Coastal AP?
x: Section 46(2)-(3) provides for grants and a special package; Section 94(1) covers tax incentives.

s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Aspirational Districts Programme launched by – Finance Commission
x: The Aspirational Districts Programme was launched by NITI Aayog, not the Finance Commission; the other pairs are correct.

s: How many districts of undivided Andhra Pradesh were covered by the Backward Regions Grant Fund (BRGF)?
x: BRGF covered 13 districts of undivided AP (9 in Telangana plus Anantapur, Chittoor, Kadapa and Vizianagaram) out of 250 in India.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Backward Regions Grant Fund (BRGF)?
o: It was delinked from central support in 2015-16
Hyderabad was among the BRGF districts
Vizianagaram was among the BRGF districts
x: The 9 Telangana BRGF districts were all except Hyderabad.

s: What is the motto of the Aspirational Districts Programme?
x: The ADP motto is Convergence, Collaboration, Competition, not Compensation.

s: How many districts are covered by NITI Aayog's Aspirational Districts Programme?
x: The ADP covers 112 districts; 250 was the BRGF coverage.

s: Which of the following is NOT one of the features associated with the Aspirational Districts Programme?
x: The three stated themes of the Aspirational Districts Programme are Convergence, Collaboration and Competition. Compensation is not one of them.

s: The Visakhapatnam Economic Region, launched on 13 November 2025, covers how many districts?
x: The Visakhapatnam Economic Region covers 10 districts; it is a region-specific growth plan, not part of the Aspirational Districts Programme.

s: How many districts in India were covered by the Backward Regions Grant Fund (BRGF)?
x: BRGF covered 250 districts in India, 13 of them in undivided Andhra Pradesh.

s: Which of the following districts of present Andhra Pradesh was NOT covered by the Backward Regions Grant Fund (BRGF)?
x: In residuary AP, BRGF covered Anantapur, Chittoor, Kadapa and Vizianagaram; Srikakulam was not among them.

s: When was the Visakhapatnam Economic Region launched?
x: The Visakhapatnam Economic Region was launched on 13 November 2025.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Visakhapatnam Economic Region:
1. It covers 10 districts.
2. It is part of NITI Aayog's Aspirational Districts Programme.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: VER covers 10 districts but is a region-specific plan, not part of the ADP.

s: The 2015 tax incentives under Section 94(1) of the AP Reorganisation Act covered notified backward districts of which of the following?
x: The incentives covered notified backward districts of both AP and Telangana, not AP alone.

s: What does Section 94(1) of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 require the Central Government to do?
o: take fiscal measures, including tax incentives, to promote industrialisation
declare the Polavaram project a national project
examine a new railway zone within six months
make a resource-gap grant for 2014-15 only
x: Sec 94(1) obliges the Centre to take fiscal measures, including tax incentives, for industrialisation; these were notified in 2015. Polavaram (national project), the railway zone (Thirteenth Schedule) and the 2014-15 resource-gap grant are separate commitments.

s: Which benefit would Special Category Status, denied to Andhra Pradesh, have given the State?
o: a 90% central share in Centrally Sponsored Schemes and tax exemptions
35% additional depreciation for all units in the State
Rs 50 crore per district per year for 13 districts
a 15% investment allowance only for Rayalaseema
x: SCS means a 90% central share of CSS and tax exemptions; it was denied. The 35% depreciation and 15% investment allowance are the notified Sec 94(1) incentives, and Rs 50 crore per district goes to 7 backward districts, not 13.

s: Between which dates must units be set up to get the 2015 tax incentives under Section 94(1)?
x: The incentives cover units set up from 1 April 2015 to 31 March 2020.

s: Which tax incentives were notified in 2015 under Section 94(1) of the AP Reorganisation Act for new plant and machinery?
o: Additional depreciation of 15% and investment allowance of 35%
Additional depreciation of 35% and investment allowance of 15%
A ten-year income tax holiday and GST exemption
Additional depreciation of 50% and investment allowance of 25%
x: The 2015 notification gave 35% additional depreciation and 15% investment allowance on new plant and machinery in notified backward districts.

s: Which Constitutional Amendment provided compensation to States for GST revenue loss?
x: The 101st Constitutional Amendment Act, 2016 provided for compensation to States for revenue loss arising from GST implementation.

s: At what level does the Centre cap its liability on the revised cost estimate of the Polavaram project?
x: The Centre caps its liability at old price levels, and rehabilitation and resettlement costs also remain disputed.

s: What was the resource-gap grant provided to Andhra Pradesh for 2014-15?
x: The resource-gap grant for 2014–15 was Rs 3,979.50 crore.

s: AP argues that post-bifurcation transfers fell short of the 14th and 15th FC recommendations and of the Prime Minister's assurances given in which House or forum?
x: AP maintains transfers fell short of the Fourteenth and Fifteenth FC recommendations and the PM's assurances in the Rajya Sabha.

s: For whom has the 16th Finance Commission discontinued revenue deficit grants?
o: States affected by GST implementation alone
x: The 16th Finance Commission has discontinued revenue deficit grants for all States.

s: What is the estimated loss to AP from the 16th Finance Commission stopping revenue deficit grants?
x: AP's loss from the end of RD grants is up to Rs 38,000 crore.

s: Which project has been proposed to carry surplus Godavari water to Rayalaseema?
x: The Polavaram–Nallamala Sagar link has been proposed to carry surplus Godavari water to Rayalaseema.

s: Why does Rayalaseema have a low population density?
x: Recurring droughts and famines are identified as the major reasons for Rayalaseema's low population density.

s: What is the Godavari-Penna link, Phase I, intended to transfer?
o: 73 TMC of Godavari flood water to the Pennar through a five-stage lift
71.5 TMC of Krishna water through a three-stage lift
3.283 lakh acres of irrigation water from the Krishna to Gundlakamma
24.20 TMC of Pennar water to the Godavari through a two-stage lift
x: Phase I of the Godavari–Penna link proposes to carry 73 TMC of Godavari flood water to the Pennar through a five-stage lift.

s: Which one of the following sets consists entirely of Rayalaseema districts?
o: Nandyal, Annamayya and Sri Satya Sai
x: Nandyal, Annamayya and Sri Satya Sai are Rayalaseema districts. Palnadu, Bapatla and NTR are coastal districts.

s: Between which rivers is the Veligonda project, reported to be 71.5% complete, designed to carry water?
x: Veligonda takes Krishna water to the Gundlakamma. Godavari to Pennar is the Godavari-Penna link (73 TMC), Godavari surplus to Nallamala Sagar is the proposed Polavaram-Nallamala Sagar link, and Nagavali-Champavathi is the North Coastal link via Thotapalli barrage.

s: When was the Sri Bagh Pact, which promised Rayalaseema priority in irrigation for ten years, concluded?
x: The Sri Bagh Pact was concluded on 16 November 1937 and promised Rayalaseema irrigation priority for ten years.

s: Rayalaseema accounts for what share of Andhra Pradesh's micro-irrigation?
x: Rayalaseema has 71% of micro-irrigation; 43% and 52% are its horticulture area and output shares.

s: How many districts does Rayalaseema have now?
x: Rayalaseema now has 8 districts; the package covered only 4 of them.

s: The Godavari-Penna link Phase I proposes to lift Godavari flood water to the Pennar in how many stages?
x: Phase I is a 5-stage lift carrying 73 TMC of Godavari flood water.

s: What share of the horticulture area of Andhra Pradesh lies in Rayalaseema?
x: Rayalaseema has 43% of AP's horticulture area; 52% is its share of output and 71% of micro-irrigation.

s: Six districts of Andhra Pradesh are in India's top 10 for micro-irrigation: five Rayalaseema districts and which other district?
x: The six AP districts in India's top 10 for micro-irrigation are five Rayalaseema districts and Prakasam.

s: Which of the following is the correct list of districts of Uttarandhra?
o: Alluri Sitharama Raju, Anakapalli, Parvathipuram Manyam, Visakhapatnam, Vizianagaram and Srikakulam
Alluri Sitharama Raju, Eluru, Anakapalli, Kakinada, Visakhapatnam and Srikakulam
Srikakulam, Vizianagaram, Prakasam, Nellore, Tirupati and Chittoor
Kurnool, Nandyal, Anantapur, Sri Satya Sai, YSR and Chittoor
x: The six Uttarandhra districts are Alluri Sitharama Raju, Anakapalli, Parvathipuram Manyam, Visakhapatnam, Vizianagaram and Srikakulam.

s: What has the lack of anchor industries in Srikakulam and Vizianagaram led to?
x: The absence of anchor industries in Srikakulam and Vizianagaram contributes to distress migration.

s: Bhogapuram airport is located in which district, with commercial operations targeted for June 2026?
x: Bhogapuram airport is located in Vizianagaram district, and commercial operations were targeted for June 2026.

s: Which district has the lowest literacy among the indicators specified for Uttarandhra?
x: Alluri Sitharama Raju district has the lowest literacy among the specified indicators, at 44.67%.

s: In the March 2026 rankings of the NITI Aayog Aspirational Districts Programme, ASR ranked first in which theme?
x: ASR ranked first in the Basic Infrastructure theme of the NITI Aayog Aspirational Districts Programme in the March 2026 rankings.

s: Which of the following pairs of tribal communities and areas is correctly matched?
o: Kotia and Porja — coastal Krishna delta
Khond and Jatapu — Bhogapuram urban area
x: Savara and Jatapu communities are associated with the Srikakulam side. Gadaba, Bagata, Kotia, Porja and Khond are associated with the Araku/Visakhapatnam agency.

s: The Nagavali-Champavathi link in North Coastal Andhra is through which barrage?
x: The Nagavali-Champavathi link runs via the Thotapalli barrage.

s: By which other name is North Coastal Andhra (Uttarandhra) also known?
x: North Coastal Andhra, the six districts from Srikakulam to Alluri Sitharama Raju, is also called Kalinga Andhra.

s: Which is the headquarters of the new Polavaram district, which has the lowest urbanisation and population density in Andhra Pradesh?
x: The new Polavaram district, with the lowest urbanisation (2.84%) and density (54), has its headquarters at Rampachodavaram.

s: Within what period did Indian Railways have to examine a new railway zone for Andhra Pradesh under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014?
o: Three months from the appointed day
One year from the appointed day
Six months from the appointed day
Two years from the appointed day
x: The Thirteenth Schedule required the Railways to examine a new zone in Andhra Pradesh within six months from the appointed day.

s: What was the obligation relating to the proposed railway zone in Andhra Pradesh under the Thirteenth Schedule?
o: Railways was required to examine establishing the zone and take an expeditious decision
The State Government was authorised to establish the zone independently
The Union Cabinet was required to establish the zone through a constitutional amendment
Railways was required to establish the zone within six months
x: The statutory wording created a feasibility-oriented obligation to examine the establishment of a zone and take an expeditious decision; it did not itself establish the zone.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about creating a new railway zone?
o: Railways is listed in Entry 22 of List II (State List)
A zone is created by an executive decision of the Ministry of Railways
A zone is brought into being by a gazette notification of the Ministry of Railways
x: Railways is a Union subject in Entry 22 of List I, not List II; a zone is made by executive decision plus gazette notification.

s: What does the Thirteenth Schedule ask Indian Railways to examine setting up in Telangana?
x: The Act asked Railways to examine a Rail Coach Factory for Telangana and a railway zone for AP.

s: For over how long had the demand for a separate railway zone in Andhra Pradesh been pressed before South Coast Railway was formed?
x: The demand had been pressed for over four decades; the statutory promise of 2014 was fulfilled only after about a decade.

s: When did South Coast Railway (SCoR) become India's 18th railway zone?
x: SCoR became India’s 18th railway zone on 1 June 2026.

s: In which year was South Coast Railway announced with its headquarters at Visakhapatnam?
x: SCoR was announced in 2019; it was gazetted on 4 May 2026.

s: When was the gazette notification for South Coast Railway issued?
x: The gazette came on 4 May 2026 and SCoR became fully operational on 1 June 2026.

s: Where was the temporary office of South Coast Railway set up in Visakhapatnam before its headquarters was built?
x: In April 2026 SCoR began work from a temporary office at Siripuram with about 100 staff; the permanent HQ is proposed at Mudasarlova.

s: Where is the Rs 184 crore zonal headquarters of South Coast Railway proposed?
x: The Rs 184 crore HQ is proposed at Mudasarlova; Siripuram has the temporary office.

s: Which was India's 17th railway zone before SCoR became the 18th?
x: Metro Railway, Kolkata, was the 17th zone and dates from 29 December 2010, before SCoR became the 18th zone.

s: Which of the following is NOT a division of South Coast Railway?
x: SCoR has Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Guntur and Guntakal divisions; Rayagada is in East Coast Railway.

s: How many divisions does South Coast Railway have?
x: SCoR has 4 divisions; South Central Railway shrinks to three.

s: How many divisions are left with South Central Railway after the formation of South Coast Railway?
x: After SCoR took Vijayawada, Guntur and Guntakal divisions, South Central Railway shrank to three divisions.

s: After South Coast Railway was formed, the non-Andhra portion of Waltair division became which division of East Coast Railway?
x: Waltair was split: its Andhra part became the Visakhapatnam division of SCoR and the rest became the new Rayagada division of East Coast Railway.

s: The Andhra part of the Waltair division became part of which division?
x: The Andhra part of Waltair became the truncated Visakhapatnam division of SCoR.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Waltair division split:
1. The new Rayagada division belongs to South Coast Railway.
2. East Coast Railway keeps K-K line revenue through Rayagada division.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Rayagada division is in East Coast Railway, not SCoR; ECoR keeps K-K line revenue through it.

s: Where is the headquarters of East Coast Railway?
x: East Coast Railway (ECoR) has its headquarters at Bhubaneswar; South Coast Railway's is at Visakhapatnam.

s: How is a dedicated railway zone in AP expected to support the Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor?
o: Raising passenger train frequency on suburban routes
Cutting freight costs and improving port connectivity
x: The dedicated zone is expected to cut freight costs for the VCIC and improve port connectivity.

s: Which line, called the 'revenue lifeline' of Waltair division, became the flashpoint of its reorganisation?
x: The Kottavalasa–Kirandul line was the revenue lifeline of Waltair division and the central flashpoint in the reorganisation dispute.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Kottavalasa-Kirandul (K-K) line dispute?
o: AP leaders offered stretches such as Koraput-Kirandul to Odisha
Odisha claimed the entire K-K line
The Centre favoured moving the entire K-K line to the new Rayagada division
Andhra Pradesh leaders offered the entire line to Odisha without reservation
x: AP leaders offered only the Odisha stretches (Koraput-Kirandul, Kuneru-Theruvali, Koraput-Rayagada), not the entire line.

s: Andhra Pradesh leaders argued that Waltair division had earned more revenue than which combination of divisions?
x: The Andhra Pradesh position was that Waltair had earned more than Vijayawada, Guntur and Guntakal combined.

s: Which of the following new railway lines in Andhra Pradesh is a dedicated line approved for a steel plant?
x: The dedicated Ramayapatnam-Kadapa steel plant line has been approved. Kotipalli-Narsapur is another new line, Errupalem-Namburu is the Amaravati rail link, and Kottavalasa-Kirandul is the disputed Waltair revenue line.

s: The proposed Amaravati rail link is associated with which of the following projects?
x: The proposed Amaravati rail link is the new Errupalem–Namburu broad-gauge line.

s: How many high-speed rail 'growth connectors' were named in the Union Budget 2026–27?
x: The 2026–27 Budget identified seven high-speed rail growth connectors, including Hyderabad–Bengaluru, Hyderabad–Chennai and Chennai–Bengaluru.

s: What was the status of electrification of the railway network in Andhra Pradesh as stated for 2026?
x: The railway network in Andhra Pradesh was stated to be 100% electrified.

s: As of 1 April 2026, how many railway projects were under way in Andhra Pradesh?
x: As of 1 April 2026, AP had 42 railway projects covering 4,768 km at a cost of Rs 77,855 crore.

s: In which month and year was the Errupalem-Amaravati-Nambur new railway line approved?
x: The 57 km Errupalem-Amaravati-Nambur line was approved in October 2024 at about Rs 2,245 crore.

s: What is the railway outlay for Andhra Pradesh in 2026-27?
x: AP's rail outlay for 2026-27 is Rs 10,134 crore, against an average of Rs 886 crore a year in 2009-14.

s: How many Amrit Bharat stations are there in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Andhra Pradesh has 74 Amrit Bharat stations; Sullurupeta near Sriharikota opened on 22 May 2025.

s: Which Amrit Bharat station near Sriharikota was opened on 22 May 2025?
x: Sullurupeta, the station near Sriharikota, was opened under the Amrit Bharat Station Scheme on 22 May 2025.

s: What is the approximate cost of the Errupalem-Amaravati-Nambur new railway line approved in October 2024?
x: The 57 km Errupalem-Amaravati-Nambur line was approved in October 2024 at about Rs 2,245 crore.

s: Which of the following Thirteenth Schedule commitments was dropped as non-feasible?
o: Examination of a new railway zone
New major port at Duggirajupatnam with Phase I by the end of 2018
Expansion of Visakhapatnam airport to international standards
x: The proposed new major port at Duggirajupatnam, for which Phase I was envisaged by the end of 2018, was dropped as non-feasible.

s: Which agency funds the Vizag-Chennai Industrial Corridor (VCIC)?
x: VCIC is an ADB-funded project, whose progress has been slow.

s: Which airports were identified under the Thirteenth Schedule for expansion to international standards?
x: The commitment covered the airports at Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada and Tirupati. All three are described as international airports in the stated status update.

s: Which new airport was dedicated on 1 August 2026?
o: Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram
x: The Bhogapuram airport was dedicated on 1 August 2026 as the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport.

s: Under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, in which districts was the Steel Authority of India Limited required to examine, within six months, the feasibility of an integrated steel plant?
x: The Act required SAIL to examine within six months the feasibility of integrated steel plants in YSR district of Andhra Pradesh and Khammam district of Telangana.

s: Under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014, what were IOC or HPCL required to examine within six months?
o: Greenfield crude refinery and petrochemical complex
Gas-based power plant and LNG terminal
x: The Act required Indian Oil Corporation or Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited to examine, within six months, a greenfield crude refinery and petrochemical complex.

s: Which Thirteenth Schedule infrastructure commitment uses the binding words 'shall develop'?
o: Integrated steel plant in YSR district
Greenfield refinery in the Kakinada region
x: Only the major port at Duggirajupatnam carries 'shall develop'; the steel plant, refinery and VCIC were only to be examined.

s: When did the South Coast Railway zone, examined under the Thirteenth Schedule, become operational?
x: SCoR, headquartered at Visakhapatnam, became operational on 1 June 2026.

s: Which port was developed by the State of Andhra Pradesh as a substitute greenfield port after Dugarajapatnam was found non-feasible?
x: After Dugarajapatnam was dropped on feasibility grounds, the State developed Ramayapatnam as the substitute greenfield port.

s: Where is the National Institute of Disaster Management (NIDM) Southern Campus promised to Andhra Pradesh under the Thirteenth Schedule located?
x: The NIDM was promised for Andhra Pradesh, with its Southern Campus at Kondapalli near Vijayawada.

s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
x: AIIMS Mangalagiri is associated with the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY), not the IIM Act, 2017. NIT Andhra Pradesh and IISER Tirupati are linked with the NITSER Act, while IIPE is linked with the IIPE Act, 2017.

s: Where is the Central University of Andhra Pradesh located?
x: CUAP is at Janthaluru; the Central Tribal University moved from near Visakhapatnam to Vizianagaram.

s: Which of the following pairs (institution – ministry) is correctly matched?
o: NIDM Southern Campus, Kondapalli – Ministry of Education
IIITDM Kurnool – Ministry of Home Affairs
NIDM Southern Campus, Kondapalli – Ministry of Electronics and IT
x: IIITDM Kurnool is an Institution of National Importance under the Ministry of Education; the NIDM Southern Campus at Kondapalli is under the Ministry of Home Affairs.

s: The Thirteenth Schedule promised Andhra Pradesh an IIT, NIT, IIM and IISER. Which of the following institutions was NOT promised?
x: The list included an IIT, NIT, IIM, IISER, IIIT and several universities, but no National Institute of Fashion Technology.

s: The Central Tribal University of Andhra Pradesh is located in which district?
x: The Tribal University was first proposed near Visakhapatnam but moved to Vizianagaram (Dattirajeru mandal).

s: Under which Act were the Central University and the Central Tribal University of Andhra Pradesh established?
x: Both were set up under the Central Universities (Amendment) Act, 2019; the 2009 Act is only the parent Act.

s: Where is NIT Andhra Pradesh located?
x: NIT Andhra Pradesh is at Tadepalligudem in West Godavari.

s: Which of the following pairs (institution – legal basis) is correctly matched?
x: AIIMS Mangalagiri was set up under PMSSY; NIT and IISER come under the NITSER Act and IIPE under the IIPE Act, 2017.

s: Where is the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Visakhapatnam located?
x: IIM Visakhapatnam is at Gambheeram on 241 acres; it started in September 2015 with IIM Bangalore as mentor.

s: Which institute is the academic mentor of the Indian Institute of Petroleum and Energy (IIPE), Visakhapatnam?
x: IIPE Visakhapatnam, the Petroleum University promised in the Act, is mentored by IIT Kharagpur.

s: Under which Act was IIT Tirupati established?
x: The Institutes of Technology (Amendment) Act, 2016 added six IITs including Tirupati.

s:
Match the following:
List-I (Institution)
a. IIM Visakhapatnam
b. NIT Andhra Pradesh
c. Central University of Andhra Pradesh
d. NIDM Southern Campus
List-II (Location)
1. Kondapalli
2. Janthaluru
3. Gambheeram
4. Tadepalligudem
x: IIM is at Gambheeram, NIT at Tadepalligudem, the Central University at Janthaluru and the NIDM Southern Campus at Kondapalli.

s: Which institute was the mentor of IIM Visakhapatnam when it started in September 2015?
x: IIM Visakhapatnam began in September 2015 with IIM Bangalore as its mentor.

s: Which of the following was NOT among the six IITs added by the Institutes of Technology (Amendment) Act, 2016?
x: The 2016 amendment added Tirupati, Palakkad, Goa, Dharwad, Bhilai and Jammu; IIT Hyderabad was not one of them.

s: Where are IIT Tirupati and IISER Tirupati both located?
x: Both IIT Tirupati and IISER Tirupati are at Yerpedu; Gambheeram is the site of IIM Visakhapatnam.

s: Where was construction launched for the JSW Rayalaseema Integrated Steel Plant on 3 July 2026?
x: Construction was launched at Sunnapurallapalli and Peddandluru villages in the Jammalamadugu constituency of Kadapa on 3 July 2026.

s: From which source is the JSW Rayalaseema Integrated Steel Plant in Kadapa to draw 2 tmc ft of water a year?
x: The scrap-based EAF plant (Rs 16,350 crore) is to draw 2 tmc ft a year from Gandikota.

s: Where did CM N. Chandrababu Naidu lay the foundation stone for the Kadapa steel plant in December 2018?
x: The Dec 2018 stone was laid at M. Kambala Dinne in Mylavaram mandal (APPSC 2018 key). Sunnapurallapalli is where JSW construction began on 3 Jul 2026, Gandikota supplies the plant's water, and Yerpedu hosts IIT and IISER Tirupati.

s: What did SAIL's feasibility report of 2 December 2014 find about the Kadapa steel plant?
o: Viable only with an EAF route
x: SAIL's report found the plant prima facie not financially viable; a Task Force followed in 2016.

s: Which State SPV was formed in November 2019 for a 3 MTPA steel plant in Kadapa?
x: Andhra Pradesh formed its own SPV, AP High Grade Steels Ltd, in November 2019 for a 3 MTPA plant.

s:
Consider the following statements about the JSW Rayalaseema Integrated Steel Plant:
1. It will cost Rs 16,350 crore in two phases.
2. It is a scrap-based Electric Arc Furnace green steel plant.
3. It was named in the AP Reorganisation Act as a SAIL plant.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: The JSW plant costs Rs 16,350 crore and uses a scrap-based EAF; the Act named SAIL only to examine a plant, while the actual plant is private JSW.

s: In which district is Dugarajapatnam, identified for a greenfield port and shipbuilding cluster under the Shipbuilding Development Scheme?
x: The greenfield port and shipbuilding cluster at Dugarajapatnam is in Tirupati district.

s: Which State Special Purpose Vehicle is developing Ramayapatnam Port?
o: Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation Ltd
x: Ramayapatnam Port is being developed by the State SPV Ramayapatnam Port Development Corporation Ltd, permitted in February 2020.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the proposed Dugarajapatnam port and shipbuilding cluster?
o: Andhra Pradesh is the only State selected for a national shipbuilding cluster
Its SPV is a 50:50 JV of the Visakhapatnam Port Authority and AP Maritime Board
The cluster is estimated to be worth ₹30,000 crore
x: It is one of five national cluster sites (others in Tamil Nadu, Gujarat, Odisha and Maharashtra); the other statements are correct.

s: Ramayapatnam Port is presently located in which district of Andhra Pradesh?
x: Ramayapatnam Port is presently in Prakasam district. Earlier material placed it in SPS Nellore district before district boundaries were redrawn.

s: The SPV for the revived Dugarajapatnam port and shipbuilding cluster is a 50:50 joint venture of which bodies?
x: National Shipbuilding and Heavy Industries Park Andhra Pradesh Ltd (2 Mar 2026) is a 50:50 JV of Visakhapatnam Port Authority and AP Maritime Board.

s: Dugarajapatnam was dropped as a major port partly because of risk to which lake?
x: The 2016 AECOM study found it not viable, with risk to Pulicat Lake and to the security of Sriharikota.

s: What is the capacity of Phase-I of Ramayapatnam Port?
x: Ramayapatnam Phase-I costs Rs 4,929.39 crore, with 4 berths and 34.04 MTPA capacity.

s: Ramayapatnam Port lies about 93 km north of which port?
x: Ramayapatnam is 93 km north of Krishnapatnam and 5 km east of Thettu on NH-16.

s: Among Andhra Pradesh's four greenfield ports, which recorded the highest progress (74.34%) in October 2025?
x: Ramayapatnam, at 74.34% in October 2025, had the highest progress of the four greenfield ports.

s: Ramayapatnam port, earlier in SPS Nellore district, lies in which mandal?
x: Ramayapatnam port was in Ulavapadu mandal of SPS Nellore district; it is now in Prakasam district.

s:
Consider the following statements about the proposed Kakinada petrochemical facility:
1. Kakinada lies outside the Visakhapatnam–Kakinada PCPIR.
2. Its MoUs were cleared by the State pollution board.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
x: MoUs for the greenfield petrochemical facility near Kakinada were cleared by the State pollution board; Kakinada lies within the Visakhapatnam–Kakinada PCPIR, so statement 1 is wrong.

s: The BPCL greenfield refinery-cum-petrochemical complex is proposed near Ramayapatnam Port between which districts?
x: The BPCL complex is proposed near Ramayapatnam Port, between Prakasam and Nellore districts, in the villages of Chevuru and Ravuru.

s: How much viability gap funding did the Centre ask Andhra Pradesh to pay for the GAIL-HPCL Kakinada petrochemical complex?
x: The Centre said Rs 5,615 crore of viability gap funding was needed for the ~Rs 32,901 crore complex; AP refused to pay.

s: What is the capacity of the proposed BPCL refinery-cum-petrochemical complex near Ramayapatnam?
x: The BPCL complex is a 9 MTPA refinery costing about Rs 1.45 lakh crore.

s: In which villages is the BPCL refinery-cum-petrochemical complex near Ramayapatnam port proposed?
x: The BPCL complex is planned at Chevuru and Ravuru villages between Prakasam and Nellore, near Ramayapatnam port.

s: What is the estimated cost of the BPCL refinery-cum-petrochemical complex near Ramayapatnam port?
x: The BPCL complex near Ramayapatnam is estimated at about Rs 1.45 lakh crore (earlier about Rs 1 lakh crore).

s: Which organisation is the implementing agency for the metro rail projects in Visakhapatnam and Vijayawada?
o: Andhra Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Ltd
x: The implementing agency for the metro rail projects in both cities is Andhra Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Ltd.

s: How many corridors and what length does the proposed Visakhapatnam metro rail project have?
x: The Visakhapatnam metro plan has 4 corridors covering 76.70 km at Rs 11,498 crore.

s: As per the January 2026 Governor's address, who had approved the Visakhapatnam and Vijayawada metro projects?
x: The Governor's address said both metros were approved by the State; the Vizag metro is still before the Centre.

s: The proposed southern AP industrial cluster links the Kadapa steel plant and the BPCL refinery with which port?
x: Kadapa steel, Ramayapatnam port and the BPCL refinery, linked by a new rail line, form the southern AP industrial cluster.
